headword: {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}

definitions.gloss: driving lane; travel lane; cruising lane
definitions.explanation: The left lane (in Japan) of a multi-lane road or expressway, intended for normal-speed driving. Contrasted with the passing lane.

examples.japanese: {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please drive in the travel lane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越し：09216_oikoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: After passing, return to the driving lane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧とし、⟦{追越車線|おいこししゃせん}→追越車線：24737_oikoshishasen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On expressways, the driving lane is the default, and the passing lane should only be used when overtaking.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧ (running, driving) + ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (lane). In Japan, where traffic drives on the left, the {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん} is the leftmost lane, and the ⟦{追越車線|おいこししゃせん}→追越車線：24737_oikoshishasen⟧ (passing lane) is on the right.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to drive in the travel lane
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return to the travel lane
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{追越車線|おいこししゃせん}→追越車線：24737_oikoshishasen⟧: travel lane and passing lane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追越車線|おいこししゃせん}→追越車線：24737_oikoshishasen⟧: passing lane — the faster lane used for overtaking
- ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧: lane — the general term for a traffic lane
- ⟦{路肩|ろかた}→路肩：20701_rokata⟧: road shoulder — the emergency strip alongside the road
